dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Heroes tend to get a chance to show their stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Tirda
dialogues.text: By that, do you mean that my singing techniques will come in useful?

dialogues.speaker: Tirda
dialogues.text: Maybe you're right. I suppose the ability to help everyone feel relaxed and happy is a gift in its own right...

dialogues.speaker: Tirda
dialogues.text: Thanks for saying that, I feel much better. Here, have some flowers. Thank you — you have no idea what a relief it was to hear your words.
